dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed-loop 'O' and open 'C' structures in the mid-dorsal field exhibit high-contrast white-to-light-grey perimeters with irregular, crenulated geometry transitioning abruptly to dark-pigmented interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of light-pigmented annular clusters concentrated in the upper central dorsal region; texture becomes increasingly diffuse and lower-contrast towards the posterior and ventral boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli in the upper-midsection form an asymmetrical, non-equilateral quadrilateral with the narrowest vertex oriented towards the anterior-dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated, linear high-intensity mark is visible on the far posterior-lateral flank, oriented horizontally, which is inconsistent with the surrounding circular topology.
